description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains used for stress testing, including both standard and reentrant grains, with methods for activation, messaging, lookup, and interleaving tests.

classes.name: StressTestGrain
classes.description: A standard Orleans grain for stress testing, supporting label management, ping, lookup, and self-deactivation.

classes.name: ReentrantStressTestGrain
classes.description: A reentrant Orleans grain for stress testing, supporting various ping methods, lookups, and interleaving tests.

classes.name: ReentrantLocalStressTestGrain
classes.description: A reentrant, stateless Orleans grain for local stress testing with similar capabilities as ReentrantStressTestGrain.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, initializes label, and logs activation.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Returns the current label of the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets the label of the grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to the grain itself.

methods.name: PingOthers
methods.description: Pings a list of other grains and waits for all responses.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Simulates lookup of multiple grains, returning their IDs and addresses.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Returns the same byte array received.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple ping method that completes immediately.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of the grain.

methods.name: PingMutableArray
methods.description: Pings another grain with a mutable byte array, possibly remote.

methods.name: PingImmutableArray
methods.description: Pings another grain with an immutable byte array, possibly remote.

methods.name: PingMutableDictionary
methods.description: Pings another grain with a mutable dictionary, possibly remote.

methods.name: PingImmutableDictionary
methods.description: Pings another grain with an immutable dictionary, possibly remote.

methods.name: InterleavingConsistencyTest
methods.description: Performs an interleaving test involving delays and concurrent access to shared data.
